title: Etale covers of a closed subscheme of an affine normal scheme with separably closed function field split into open pieces, and finite surjective ones have sections
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma describes etale covers of a closed subscheme of an affine integral normal scheme with separably closed function field: they split into finitely many open subschemes, and a finite surjective one has a section (statement lines 14389-14396). The proof (proof lines 14398-14422) lifts the cover to an affine etale cover of the ambient scheme and applies the structure lemma for normal schemes, then decomposes the finite surjective case into open immersions that are simultaneously closed and reads off a section from the induced open-and-closed decomposition of Z. H2: one lift and one decomposition argument, written out.
